pairs.why: B's locomotive is built like a real engine (boiler, cowcatcher, rods, coal tender) with calmer, softer shading like the bus and bike cards, while A is a chunky, glossy toy block.
A has the softer, more matte finish and the detailed, real-object build of the bus and bike cards, while B's bright red, glossy side view reads more like a plastic toy.
Both badges are well built, but B's gold is softer and calmer, while A pushes extra gloss, a heavily faceted gem and very saturated colour, which the lessons say not to reward.
